text: Bronchoscopic biopsy of right lower lobe mass. DIAGNOSIS: Adenocarcinoma, lung, moderately differentiated. Immunohistochemistry: TTF-1 positive, Napsin A positive, CK7 positive, p40 negative. Molecular testing: EGFR mutation detected (Exon 19 deletion). ALK rearrangement: Negative. PD-L1 expression: 45% by IHC. COMMENT: The morphologic and immunohistochemical findings are consistent with primary lung adenocarcinoma. Molecular profile suggests candidacy for targeted EGFR therapy.
